title: On the $L_p$ Brunn--Minkowski inequality for planar dual quermassintegrals
summary: We determine the sharp $L_p$ Brunn--Minkowski range for planar dual quermassintegrals on origin-symmetric convex bodies: $0 2$. Together with the known logarithmic and endpoint results, we obtain the complete equality classification: only positive dilates occur, except at $(p,q)=(0,2)$, where parallelograms with corresponding sides parallel also give equality.
